$comment: A person: a team member, a record with no login (team members and login accounts are separate, by the founder's ruling of 18/11/2026). The fields are flat. contract/collections/team.json carries them, and a post's author is a relationship to team, so the author box reads the same record: the person and the author are one shape. Limits by the ruling of 18/11/2026 (question 3): a name 120 characters, a role 80, a bio 600, socials 0 to 10. The public email is the team member's own field, never a login address.

nextjs.owes: a team collection separate from login accounts, whose records hold these fields (users holds the team today); a count as the editor types, beside the target of 60, which is never refused

wordpress.owes: a count as the editor types, beside the target of 60, which is never refused
